jordan (PM): quick pre-GA smoke: need a minimal checklist we can hand to compliance and sales. Focus: promised SLAs, who owns alerts, docs for customers, and pricing fallback.
sasha (SRE): propose the SLOs: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 400ms, availability >= 99.95%. add explicit degraded-mode behavior when error budget hits 100%.
mike (ProdOps): confirm we have an exercised fallback: model-quantized path and region spillover. I'll run a short blackbox sim tomorrow 06:30 PT.
neil (FinOps): two quick pricing fallbacks for pilots: (1) surge credits with 1.5x surcharge, (2) soft-throttle discount. I'll put numbers into a tiny table.
claire (Support): need three customer-facing docs: SLA summary, outage notification template, and billing dispute playbook. also want runbook owners listed.
ruta (Docs): typo: I'm ruta (Docs) — I can scaffold those pages and include sample payloads and cost math examples.
sasha (SRE): alert set: p95 breach 5m, burn_rate >2 for 60m. will wire synthetic traffic (mix short/long) into the perf dashboard.
mike (ProdOps): scheduling failover run; will post artifacts and a short confluence page with results.
neil (FinOps): include auto-throttle clause: sustained >3x baseline for 15m triggers throttling unless burst credits enabled.
claire (Support): assigning owners: model regressions -> research-oncall; infra latency -> infra-oncall; billing -> finops-team.
deploy-bot: Deployment: prod-serving/v1.9 rolled out 2024-07-10T14:01Z.
jordan (PM): thanks — owners, please upload deliverables by tomorrow EOD. we'll do a final 20m readout 09:00 PT. :rocket:
